# wso2is_api_resource (Resource)

Manages an API resource and its scopes. An API resource represents one of your APIs, and each scope is one permission in that API, such as `orders:read`. Use `wso2is_application_authorized_api` to let an application request the scopes, and `wso2is_role` to grant the scopes to users. To import an API resource, use its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_api_resource" "orders" {
  name        = "Orders API"
  identifier  = "https://api.example.com/orders"
  description = "Order management"
  scopes = [
    { name = "orders:read", display_name = "Read orders" },
    { name = "orders:write", display_name = "Change orders", description = "Create and update orders" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier, usually the API's base URL (it becomes the `aud` of tokens). Changing it replaces the API resource.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `authorization_details_types` (Attributes Set) Rich authorization request (RFC 9396) types accepted by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization_details_types))
- `description` (String) Description.
- `requires_authorization` (Boolean) Whether applications must be authorized for the API before they can request its scopes. The server only accepts this value at creation. The default is `true`.
- `scopes` (Attributes Set) Scopes of the API. Scope names must be unique across the tenant. Changes replace the whole scope set on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) API resource ID.
- `scope_ids` (Map of String) Scope IDs by scope name.
- `type` (String) The type of the API resource. APIs that you create with this resource have the type `BUSINESS`.

<a id="nestedatt--authorization_details_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authorization_details_types`

Required:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `schema` (String) JSON Schema the authorization details must match (use `jsonencode`).
- `type` (String) Unique type value used in `authorization_details`.


<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Required:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `name` (String) Scope name, as requested by applications, for example `orders:read`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_api_resource.orders <api_resource_id>
```
